items.title: Python Modules
items.content: A Python module is a file containing Python definitions and statements. Modules help organize application code into reusable and maintainable components.

items.title: Python Virtual Environments
items.content: A virtual environment creates an isolated Python environment for a project. It prevents dependencies from one project from interfering with dependencies from another project.

items.title: JSON File Storage
items.content: JSON is a human-readable data format commonly used for configuration, APIs, and simple persistent storage. Python provides built-in JSON support through the json module.
